# Repository coding instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first and follow the repository-specific documents it names.

For normal development, use `PLAN -> CHANGESET -> VERIFY -> VERDICT`, keep changes small, and use the repository's existing verification commands and CI.

When working through GitHub, group related multi-file edits into one coherent commit when possible instead of making a separate commit for every file. Work from the intended base branch, keep unrelated work unchanged, and record the exact commit SHA and verification result in the pull request.

Follow the repository's existing review and merge rules. These instructions are workflow guidance only and do not replace project authority.
